method: Separate internal LLM rubric review of the complete candidate corpus against the pinned source pack; no evaluation responses or provider secrets supplied
scope: All nine equivalent variants and two controls for each of six objectives
rubric: Equivalent meaning and coverage of objective key ideas
No extra facts in held-out paraphrases
Clear incomplete versus contradiction controls, especially replication
No unintended cross-objective demonstrations, especially scaling versus sharding
limitations: This records an independent machine review, not human native-speaker certification or calibrated model accuracy. Replication incomplete deliberately omits the failure-tolerance purpose. A reviewer should revisit rubric ambiguities rather than tune expected verdicts to a candidate model's outputs.
